subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 11: Get ready for A1 Movers & Fun corner
outcomes: Listen carefully and match names to people in a picture.
Say differences between two pictures using 'but'.
Use landscape words and comparatives in a board game.

tf.s: Before you listen, look at the picture carefully.
tf.why: Yes! Looking first helps you listen.

tf.s: In Speaking Part 1 you find four differences.
We use 'but' to join two different facts.
'Miss a turn' means you play two times.
tf.why: Miss a turn means you don't play in the next turn.

tf.s: 'Spin again' means you have another go.
tf.why: Yes! You spin one more time.

tf.s: 'Go forward two spaces' means you move back.
tf.why: Forward means you move ahead two spaces.

tf.s: 'The path is shorter than the road' uses a comparative.
'You climb the higher hill' is the superlative.
'The river is wide, but the road is narrow' shows a difference.
tf.why: Yes! wide and narrow are different.

tf.s: You don't need to listen to names in Listening Part 1.
tf.why: You listen and match the names to people.

boxes.q: In Listening Part 1, you match names to ...
boxes.why: You match names to people in the picture.

boxes.q: How many differences do you find?
boxes.why: In Speaking Part 1 you find four.

boxes.q: The path is ___ than the road.

boxes.why: You wait and don't play next time.

boxes.q: What do you do before you listen?
boxes.why: Look at the picture carefully first.

boxes.q: In picture A there are three mountains, ___ in picture B there are four.

mcq.q: What should you do before you listen?
mcq.why: Looking first helps you know the words.

mcq.q: What do you do in A1 Movers Listening Part 1?
o: Listen and match names to people.
mcq.why: You listen and draw lines from names to people.

o: You don't play in the next turn.

mcq.q: What does 'Go forward two spaces' mean?
Complete: In picture A the river is wide, but in picture B it's ___ .
Complete the square: The river is ___ than the road.
Picture A: three mountains. Picture B: four mountains. Choose the best sentence.
o: In picture A there are three mountains, but in picture B there are four.
In picture A there are four mountains, but in picture B there are three.
In picture A and picture B there are three mountains.
There are no mountains in picture B.
mcq.why: Say each picture correctly and join them with 'but'.

o: The path is shorter than the road.

mcq.q: Which is the best new board game square?
o: The lake is deeper than the river. Go forward one space.
mcq.why: It has a correct comparative sentence and a rule.

mcq.q: Why do we use 'but' in 'The road is long, but the path is short'?
o: The two facts are the same.
